analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing if an older [product_name] hardware module is compatible with a newer [product_name] software. The software recognizes older hardware in configuration, but some features like cloud connectivity require both newer hardware and firmware. Users encounter confusion regarding which features are supported and receive errors related to version compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] software [version_no] to work seamlessly with hardware modules like [product_name] [version_no], and that all features—including cloud connectivity—will be supported.
